name: Daido Metal Co., Ltd.
summary: Daido Metal Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of bearings in Japan, North America, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers metal-polymer plain bearings used in various applications, including office and construction equipment, high-speed vehicles, trains, domed stadiums, and others, as well as hydro, thermal, and nuclear power plants.
